name: ghostswap-partners-api
description: Add no-KYC crypto-to-crypto swaps (1,600+ coins) to any AI agent via the GhostSwap Partners API.
long_description: Model Context Protocol server for the GhostSwap Partners API. Lets Claude (Desktop / Code / .ai) and any other MCP client list currencies, quote swap rates, validate addresses, create idempotent swaps, and poll status. Auth uses a partner-issued Bearer token (`gspk_live_…:gssk_live_…`) read from env vars.

public_key.title: Public key
public_key.description: Your GhostSwap partner public key (looks like `gspk_live_…`). Get it from https://partners.ghostswap.io/dashboard/api-credentials.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Your GhostSwap partner secret (looks like `gssk_live_…`). Reveal it via the audit-logged Reveal button on the credentials page.

api_base.title: API base URL
api_base.description: Override only if pointing at a non-production environment. Defaults to https://partners-api.ghostswap.io.
